## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:engine` · `area:workflow`, into `pm:queue`. Direction: the door's unit also covers an `after*` hook carrying a `condition`

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-11T14:57Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane:** the write door's unit-opening predicate and `hook-wrappers.ts` (`packages/objectql`) are `domain:engine`.
- **Why p2:** the caller is refused while the row is stored. That is the outcome #22782 removes for `abort` hooks, here reached through a `condition`.
- **The rules already in force:**
  - #4775 (`hook-wrappers.ts` `:100`–`:124`): an unevaluable condition aborts the operation, regardless of `onError`.
  - #22782's direction (A): when an `after*` hook can abort the write, the door opens a unit so the abort rolls back.
  - Together they decide it. ⛔ No decision card is owed.
- **Direction: the first option the card lists.** The door's unit-opening predicate also counts an `after*` hook that carries a `condition`, whatever its `onError`, because #4775 makes that condition able to abort. The row is then rolled back with the refusal.
  - The card's third option (a load-time refusal of a condition that can never bind on its event) is a good follow-up, but it is a new refusal on authoring. ⛔ It is not folded in here. File it if the claimant measures real configurations that hit it.
  - The sanitised `500` (rather than a `4xx` naming the hook and its key) is noted. It is the same class as #22764's fault-text work, ⛔ not this card's.
- **Pins:**
  - `onError: 'log'` with an unbindable condition → refused, row absent;
  - CONTROL: `log` with a bindable condition → the row is stored and the hook error is logged;
  - CONTROL: an `abort` hook → as #22782 leaves it.
- **Sequence:** after PR #22819 merges (same predicate). This is ordering, not a block. `Clause-②: no`.

Claim: PM loop round 1 · 2026-10-11T22:10Z
Session: `session_01ADzJtzYTLUfgrRZHxkagkX`

Worktree: `objectstack-issue-22856`

Seat: `domain:engine#2` (seat post #20966); the lane's only seated PM
File surface (read on `origin/main` `63739521d8`; stop on a breach and explain it in the report). ⛔ Classes, positions and functions only, in every artefact.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`: the write door's unit-opening predicate `opensAfterAbortUnit`, which today counts only an `after*` hook whose `onError` is `abort`; per triage 6110316957 it also counts an `after*` hook that carries a `condition`, whatever its `onError`.
- read-mostly: `packages/objectql/src/hook-wrappers.ts` (#4775's condition gate and `HookConditionError`, raised outside `onError`); edit only if the predicate needs a shared reading of "carries a condition".
- tests beside the code (`packages/objectql/src/engine-after-hook-abort-unit.test.ts` or a sibling); a real-door pin in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/` (test-only, the place PR #22819's and PR #22894's pins live), if no real driver is reachable from `objectql`; one changeset.
- ⛔ Not the sanitised `500` text (triage: #22764's class), not a load-time refusal of an unbindable condition (triage: a follow-up, filed only on measured configurations).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default` (`dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
- The write was already refused; with this change the refused write's row is rolled back too. No accept set or export changes.
Responsibility: `objectql`'s write door, whose `opensAfterAbortUnit` leaves an `after*` hook with `onError: 'log'` outside the unit although #4775's `HookConditionError` aborts it regardless of `onError` | #22782's door unit (PR #22819), which already rolls back an aborting `abort` hook | any caller of a write door on an object carrying such a hook; measured once on REST `createData` on the verify stack (500, row stored)
Thread-read: 6110316957
Serial constraints cleared: PR #22819 (#22782, the same predicate) landed; #22855 (the same predicate, closed-handle reading) landed as PR #22894 (`63739521d8`). Open PRs on `engine.ts`: #22891 (#22519, the master-detail header read, a disjoint region; held) and #22874 (#22340, one line in `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS`, disjoint). No open PR touches `hook-wrappers.ts`, the after-hook-abort unit test or the dogfood pin.
